title: Standing bridge: runtime sync agenda & action tracker
content:
Purpose: prep notes for the weekly standing bridge-style runtime sync. Make this meeting a concise flywheel: quick health + one focused deep-dive (rotating owner), then 20m of action assignment and unblock triage.

Meeting logistics:
- Cadence: weekly, Monday 09:30 PT (30m)
- Attendees: eng-serving-runtime core on-call, infra console lead, SRE rep (rotating), product-hosted-api as needed
- Rotation: every week a different owner leads the deep-dive and brings a 5–7 min micro-brief + 3 talking slides (notes allowed).

Agenda (30m):
1) 5m — Quick health snapshot (owner: on-call)
   - p50/p95 token latency (last 24h): note anomalies
   - error budget usage: % consumed this week 
   - Dedicated capacity queue depth: any saturation events
2) 10m — Weekly themed deep-dive (owner: rotation)
   - This week (Rhea): console-side UX gap causing delayed model swaps under heavy load
   - Problem statement, recent repro steps, sandboxed mitigation tried
   - Data to bring: trace of slow swap (trace ids), k8s pod event snapshots, rollout policy config snippet
3) 10m — Action & unblock triage (all)
   - Review active blocking tickets (<= 2 min per ticket)
   - Assign owners & ETA; clarify acceptance criteria
4) 5m — Parking lot & follow-ups (Rhea captures)
content_short_notes: Quick notes to self: bring p95 graph, console logs for swap, link to PR that partially reverted earlier fix. Ask Console PM about expected UX for swap cancel. Consider fallback: force-fallback to earlier model variant when swap delay > 6s.
action_items: RWINF-4123 Liam: attach full trace and timeline by Tue EOD
RWINF-4056 Priya: prototype a server-side prefetch for model artifacts (spike) — 3d
Diego: add metric for model-swap-duration to runtime-metrics dashboard — ETA Thu
Rhea: draft short decision doc on acceptable swap timeout thresholds and post to #bridge-rotations by Wed
open_questions: Is the console allowed to preemptively pull artifacts for canary variants? (security + disk constraints)
What is a tolerable p95 increase during controlled bursts for customer tier = dedicated?
